title: Al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Qur'an
author: al-suyuti
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Suyuti's encyclopaedia of the Qur'anic sciences in eighty chapters, covering revelation, collection, readings, abrogation, rhetoric, interpretation and the history of the text. It synthesises earlier scholarship and remains a standard survey.
historicalContext: Written in Mamluk Cairo at the end of the fifteenth century. Al-Suyuti drew on the libraries and scholars of Cairo to produce a comprehensive classification of the field.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
